external_evidence: The crash report shows the uv process itself aborting (Terminating Process: uv, Thread 1 Crashed in main2 via abort() after a Tokio worker panic). The panic originates in uv's own runtime, not in the host app, OS, or a dependency. The host (opencode) is only the spawner; nothing in the report points to another tool's defect.
rationale: The reporter labels this a bug and it is one: uv panics and aborts when run with piped stdio and no TTY, which is uv misbehaving rather than documented or intended behaviour. The crash summary points at uv's own process and Tokio runtime, so this is not external. needs_mre is true because the report lacks the exact command, the panic message and backtrace text (the stack is truncated), and a standalone reproduction. Two searches of issues (SIGABRT/panic/non-TTY and macOS crash wording) found no duplicates, and a docs search on non-interactive/pipe behaviour found nothing that documents this behaviour as intended.
